routes.implementation: Lazy ServiceIntelligencePage inside SafeRoute named ServiceIntelligence.

purpose: Compare selected-vehicle decoded context and observed symptoms against service, recall and official manufacturer-communication records, with explicit source and interpretation limits.
primaryGoal: Review potentially relevant service hypotheses and warranty outlook, inspect authoritative evidence and provenance, and prepare a service ticket without treating matches as confirmed faults, eligibility or completed repairs.

dataSources.sourceOwnership: Frontend typed hook returns server-assembled vehicle_context, summary, recall_findings, communications, ranked_symptoms, evidence and sources. Backend service/integrations own retrieval, matching and normalized catalog semantics; their algorithms were not audited.
dataSources.behavior: Vehicle-scoped query key includes refresh; enabled only for truthy vehicleId; analytics staleTime; AbortSignal forwarded. This page does not request refresh=true. Retry refetches the existing query.

dataSources.sourceOwnership: Server returns coverage names, expiration, days_remaining, km_limit/km_remaining, status, basis and assumption. No independent verification of coverage or odometer source.
dataSources.behavior: Analytics staleTime, vehicle-enabled, cancellation forwarded; optional odometer_km supported by hook but not passed by this page. Coverage assumptions stay visible.

dataSources.sourceOwnership: Backend composes subject, vehicle, issue, coverages, communications, symptoms, evidence, ask, body and disclaimer. Frontend submits the issue and copies the exact returned body.
dataSources.behavior: Historical query policy; key includes vehicle, submitted issue and optional odometer. Query disabled until submitted issue is non-null; empty string is not rejected by frontend enablement. Current edits and submitted text are separate local states. AbortSignal forwarded.
dataSources.backendRuntime: unverified; scopedPath implementation and server issue validation not inspected

dataSources.sourceOwnership: Global normalized catalog, not selected vehicle inventory. Status returns latest attempt, latest success and record count.
dataSources.behavior: Independent of vehicle selection; moderate staleTime; retry=1; cancellation forwarded. Permission guidance remains available on initial catalog error.

dataSources.sourceOwnership: Official static.nhtsa.gov ODI TSB ZIP artifacts for 2005–2009, 2010–2014, 2015–2019, 2020–2024 and 2025–2026. Backend import/normalization and catalog storage own record content.
dataSources.behavior: Client rejects non-allow-listed URLs; requiresLiveMode=true; successful import invalidates catalog and vehicle query families. Sudo cancellation is suppressed in page error and mutation toast. Router declares RequireSudo and 10/hour IP throttle. These are source declarations, not exercised enforcement.
dataSources.backendRuntime: unverified; no import or authentication action performed

dataSources.endpoint: Indirect useVehicles dependency; its endpoint was not inspected in this bounded audit.
dataSources.behavior: Effective selection resolves URL, persisted valid selection, then first vehicle; null yields persistent selection prompts. No second selector or date picker in the page.

components.name: PageLayout / PageContainer
components.contract: Existing PageContainer props: title, subtitle, secondaryActions, query. PageLayout supplies w-full/min-w-0 container composition; query affects header freshness, not whole-body fatal replacement.

components.name: LayoutCard
components.contract: title, optional description/actions/footer/size, children; shared Card shell with labelled heading, min-w-0 body and description help.
dependsOn: Existing Card, Heading, Text, Tooltip and Button primitives

components.name: PanelState / SourceContent
components.contract: selected/loading/error/empty, source-specific messages and icon, onRetry, children. Selection prompt precedes loading; fatal error only replaces its own panel body; persistent shell remains.

components.name: useDataState / StaleRefreshWarning
components.contract: Retained payload and fatalError differ from refreshError. Warning accepts state and localized label, exposes retry and offline/paused copy without hiding retained content.

components.name: OperationalBrief / useOperationalMetrics
components.contract: compact, title/description/eyebrow, source-derived statusLabel/statusTone, scope, freshness, provenance and metrics. Shared Review details action must survive. Count metrics preserve rawValue, occurrenceId and source descriptions.
components.limit: Metric bridge implementation path was not resolved; failed read of useOperationalMetrics.ts provides no implementation proof. OperationalBrief inspected only through line 170, not full drawer behavior.

components.name: UI, feedback, motion and date primitives
components.contract: Reuse Button, Input, CopyButton, Badge, Table, Heading/Text/Caption; AlertBanner, EmptyState, Skeleton, PermissionGuidanceNotice; FadeIn; DateTime. CopyButton takes returned draft.body, withToast and localized label.
dependsOn: Existing locale, number preferences, reduced-motion, permission, clipboard and shell focus contracts
components.limit: Most primitive implementation behavior is an existing dependency, not independently validated here.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Four official-source link implementations repeat fixed cyan text/ring, min-h-11, external-link icon and new-tab security attributes; unavailable-provider link adds an amber version.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Use existing semantic button/link chrome and tokenized text/focus consistently, retaining native anchor navigation, full localized labels and rel attributes. First verify existing primitive supports this; do not create a competing link library.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Repeated panel state handling is already consolidated in a feature adapter to SourceContent; vehicle selection is a genuine domain prerequisite, not a new global state system.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Retain this adapter and source-local messages; do not duplicate loading/error renderers during modernization.

existingStrategy: Page action flex-wrap and full-width below sm: ServiceIntelligencePage.tsx:65.
Communications/symptoms stack until xl two columns: ServiceIntelligencePage.tsx:164.
Claim input/action stack below sm: ClaimDraftPanel.tsx:74.
Recall title/badges stack below sm and consequence/remedy split at md: RecallFindingCard.tsx:37,74.
Artifact periods split at lg, freshness sources at lg three columns: CommunicationsCatalogPanel.tsx:230; SourceFreshnessPanel.tsx:46.
Shared compact summary uses one column, sm two, md three, 1920px six: OperationalBrief.tsx:168-169.

issues.detail: Artifact filenames are long unbroken strings in a flex item without explicit min-w-0/break-words. Similar long source titles, signal IDs and evidence text can pressure narrow cards. Clipping is a risk, not observed runtime failure.
issues.fix: Add source-preserving wrap/min-width rules to feature content and test long filenames/IDs at 320px, text zoom and RTL without truncating provenance.

issues.detail: Coverage label/details and status share a non-wrapping horizontal flex row; translation and text zoom could squeeze badge and details.
issues.fix: Allow responsive row reflow and retain expiration, days, distance, status and assumption at all widths.

accessibility.status: source-only; keyboard, screen-reader, contrast, focus and touch acceptance unverified
positiveEvidence: Native external anchors have noopener/noreferrer, visible localized labels, minimum 44px height and explicit focus rings.
Claim input has localized aria-label: ClaimDraftPanel.tsx:79.
Artifact imports have period-specific accessible names: CommunicationsCatalogPanel.tsx:261-265.
Vehicle context uses shared Table with aria-label and row-header scope: VehicleMatchPanel.tsx:115-132.
Semantic ordered lists retain server record order; status/confidence/applicability are text, not color alone.
Shared SourceContent loading status and retained-data warning live region exist; route focus target is declared in PageContainer.tsx:182-196.

issues.detail: Match factor detail exists only as native title on Badge; no explicit keyboard/touch disclosure is supplied by this caller. Essential matching explanation may be hard to access without hover.
issues.fix: Use existing Tooltip/help or visible expandable evidence detail with a named keyboard-accessible trigger; preserve dimension, status, detail and ordering.

states.initialLoading: Each vehicle panel uses PanelState and four-line Skeleton; catalog supplies five-line Skeleton through SourceContent. Shells remain mounted.
states.noVehicle: Catalog stays independently available; eight vehicle panels retain selection prompts; evidence-pack action disabled. Workspace owner supplies selection, not a local picker.
states.empty: Domain-specific empty states preserve valid zero inventories, missing vehicle context, missing evidence and ungenerated claim distinctions.
states.fatalError: Each source uses useDataState.fatalError and local recovery; page query prop drives header freshness only. Catalog permission guidance is source-local.
states.retainedRefreshError: Catalog/service/warranty/claim warnings appear with retained data; failed import does not replace latest successful import metadata.
states.offline: StaleRefreshWarning contains paused/offline-specific copy when retained data exists. Initial offline/paused behavior needs runtime checking; page passes isLoading rather than an explicit offline source state.
states.sourceStale: TSB source status has independent stale/unavailable text. Catalog freshness threshold is eight days from latest successful completed_at, invalid dates stale, no success unavailable.
states.mutating: All artifact buttons disabled during any import; selected artifact gets loading state. Claim generate disabled without vehicle or while fetching; sudo cancellation is not shown as import failure.

issues.rule: MDC-026/MDC-045; unknown is not an authoritative negative result
issues.detail: If communicationsSource is null, neither unavailable nor stale branch applies; zero records then claim the official normalized index returned no communications. Page explicitly passes null when the expected source ID is absent, so missing provenance can be presented as a verified empty inventory.
issues.fix: Distinguish absent source metadata from an available source with a valid empty inventory; retain records if present and explain unknown availability without fabricating a backend result.

issues.detail: DraftBody directly maps coverages and reads communications.length; RecallFindingCard maps match_factors and CommunicationsPanel reads symptom_matches.length. Hook types promise arrays, but no runtime normalization was inspected. JSON null would crash; actual backend null behavior is unknown.
issues.fix: Confirm server contract and defensively normalize optional arrays where warranted, preserving valid empty versus unavailable meaning. Do not claim an existing production crash without a response.

visualIssues.detail: Fixed text-cyan-300 and cyan focus-ring chrome are repeated across source links and decorative heading icons; unavailable-source link uses amber-200. These are not neon classes, but are dark-oriented hues without explicit light-theme counterparts or semantic tokens. Actual contrast is unmeasured.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing theme-aware semantic link/focus/text tokens; mute decorative heading icons. Retain semantic warning distinction and verify composed light/dark/custom contrast.

visualIssues.detail: Hypothesis panels and latest-import block repeat cyan-tinted borders/backgrounds (also CommunicationsPanel.tsx:137 and CommunicationsCatalogPanel.tsx:183). Multiple info/confidence/matching badges compete with important safety warnings. This is a source-level saturation/noise concern, not a screenshot finding.
visualIssues.fix: Use neutral semantic surfaces for explanatory material and reserve accent/severity emphasis for safety and action priority; preserve all hypothesis and confidence text.

architectureIssues.detail: Warranty expiration is interpolated as raw c.expires_at rather than existing DateTime; km_remaining is numerically formatted with a fixed km label rather than selected physical-unit display. Hook explicitly exposes km fields and odometer_km parameters. Those are observed contracts, not inferred SI meters.
architectureIssues.fix: Reuse existing date formatting and coordinate a typed warranty display/SI contract with integration owner before conversion. Preserve current km wire/query values and coverage assumptions; never silently reinterpret kilometers as meters or rename the API in a presentation-only change.

priority.rationale: Already decomposed and using canonical layouts, summaries and retained-source warnings. Highest priority is unknown TSB provenance and accessible match explanations, followed by theme-aware restraint and long-content reflow. Warranty wire/display review needs integration coordination.

sharedChangeAssessment: No evidence-backed new shared component or shared API extension is required by this one-page audit. Reuse existing SourceContent, LayoutCard, Tooltip/help, semantic typography/link chrome, DateTime, OperationalBrief and metric bridge. Warranty wire/display concerns belong to integration review, not unauthorized shared edits. No second independent routed consumer was inspected to justify a new composite.

competingImplementations.detail: Local raw expiration rendering coexists with DateTime in recall, communications, evidence summaries and source timestamps.
competingImplementations.fix: Adopt existing formatting owner without altering source dates or countdown calculations.

competingImplementations.detail: Repeated feature-local tinted explanatory boxes and external-link styling overlap the existing surface and button/link contract; no new theme/layout/query system was observed.
competingImplementations.fix: Consolidate through existing primitives, not a second global presentation implementation.

preservation.lineCountScope: Assigned page plus eleven production component TSX files; tests and index.ts excluded.

sections.name: Service hypotheses, not findings of fault
Official NHTSA TSB catalog
sections.keep: Global summary, official artifact periods, latest success/attempt, rows read/imported/rejected, hash, idempotency/step-up copy and permission guidance.

sections.name: Vehicle match context
sections.keep: Make/model/year/assembly/firmware/build basis, four raw summary counts, source context and report generation time.

sections.name: Warranty countdown
sections.keep: Every coverage, expiration, remaining-day zero clamp, nullable remaining-distance distinction, status and assumption.

sections.name: Warranty claim draft
sections.keep: Editable versus submitted issue, returned ticket, coverages/communications/ask/disclaimer and exact full copied body, including server symptoms/evidence.

sections.name: Recall inventory
sections.keep: Server order, titles/components, applicability/confidence, completion unknown, safety warning, hypothesis, consequences/remedy, factors/details, OTA, report date and campaign source.

sections.name: Manufacturer communications & TSBs
sections.keep: Unavailable and stale provider explanation, official-document links, type/number/component/date, hypothesis/confidence and symptom overlap; no fabricated records.

sections.name: Ranked observed symptoms
sections.keep: Ranked order, signal/campaign/severity/score/evidence and observation time; overlap is not proof of fault.

sections.name: Source freshness
sections.keep: All sources and order, availability/staleness/unavailability, record count, checked/fetched times, cache provenance, detail and source URL.

preservation.countCaveat: Shared OperationalBrief internally uses GlassPanel; direct feature tag count is not the rendered card count.

actions.name: Import/refresh each official period
actions.keep: Five allow-listed artifacts, period-specific names, loading/disabled state, latest-success badge and step-up cancellation.

actions.name: Retry vehicle service source
actions.keep: Same source refetch exposed across source-dependent panel error recovery.

actions.name: Edit issue and draft ticket
actions.keep: Exact submitted issue, existing empty-string behavior until validation ownership is reviewed.

actions.name: Copy ticket text / retry draft
actions.keep: Copy exact draft.body with toast, source disclaimer and query refetch.

actions.name: Review details on both summaries
actions.keep: Existing shared details action and complete source context; drawer runtime not audited.

actions.name: Open official/source references
actions.keep: Original URLs, new-tab semantics and security attributes.

actions.name: Refresh retained sources
actions.keep: Nonblocking source retry, disabled during refresh.

dataBehavior: No fake data or client-side applicability calculations; server summary and rankings remain source-owned.
Vehicle selection and source-specific windows stay distinct; no local date picker or invented range endpoint.
Global catalog count and allow-listed artifact count are not vehicle matching counts or proof all periods were imported.
Latest failed import does not overwrite the presentation of last successful catalog; no success means Not imported.
Retained data stays visible on refresh failure; source-local fatal errors do not erase independent neighbors.
Unknown completion is not completed; recall applicability and TSB hypotheses require authoritative confirmation.
Nullable distance remains absent rather than zero; current km wire fields remain unchanged pending integration contract work.
Claim draft symptoms/evidence are carried in exact copied body although they are not separate rendered lists.

Current recall warning chooses park_it before park_outside when both are true: RecallFindingCard.tsx:57-65. Do not silently remove either underlying flag; simultaneous-warning behavior needs deliberate future review.

evidenceLimits.basis: Read-only source audit; only owned JSON and heartbeat written.
evidenceLimits.runtime: NOT EXERCISED: route mounting, API responses, backend retrieval/import/authorization, clipboard, navigation, offline, keyboard, screen reader, focus, browser console and query behavior.
evidenceLimits.visual: NOT EXERCISED: screenshots, actual composed contrast, themes/custom palette, reduced motion, RTL, viewport and allocated-container widths.
evidenceLimits.checksNotRun: No Git, agents, production actions, full-repository lint/build, TypeScript or test runner. Skill audit.sh was inspected but not executed because it unconditionally runs project TypeScript, outside this Phase 0 source-only assignment.

sourceChecks.limit: Text-pattern counts, not AST validation or runtime style proof. First case-insensitive page-only raw-element probe matched imported Button; corrected case-sensitive probe found zero. Shared inherited styling is not covered by this zero count.

evidenceLimits.backend: Only router registration and delegated handler first 110 lines inspected. No service algorithms, databases, catalog integrity, response-null guarantee or warranty entitlement proof.
evidenceLimits.partialReads: App.tsx, router.go, workspaceScope.ts and client.ts inspected only through targeted searches/ranges. Mission and contract read in relevant ranges. Shared owners inspected selectively, not full application foundations.
evidenceLimits.unresolved: useOperationalMetrics.ts read failed because that concrete .ts path does not exist; imported bridge ownership is known from callers/contract but implementation not resolved. Historical source test matches are not executed acceptance.
evidenceLimits.sourceDrift: This report describes the inspected concurrent-work snapshot; source hash is the assigned page baseline. Other writers may change dependencies after inspection.
